OnlyRoom:
Specify the room. If you leave blank, it uses the default.

Only in a specific room, if not filled in, it will be the default.

1. Determine if the hero has exclusive dialogue for the current room. If so, randomly select one from the general dialogue group and the room-exclusive dialogue group, and then play them in sequence. If there is no special dialogue, play the general dialogue.
2. Based on the number of clicks, dialogues 1-4 will be played in the order of clicks, and from the 5th click onwards, the 5th dialogue will be repeatedly played.
3. When to reevaluate whether this instance is special or ordinary--the time elapsed since the last dialogue click is greater than or equal to 30 seconds, the logic related to the number of exits will be reevaluated.
